page.overview:
Who is Adams?

Human (formerly)|status=Deceased|cod=Head crushed and tongue ripped off by Jonathan Joestar}} Adams (アダムス, Adamusu) is a Zombie created by Dio Brando, whose only characteristic is a long sharp tongue, who lurks around Windknight's Lot. Formerly a human and villager of Windknight, the zombie meets the Joestar Group and after a brief conversation with Poco, tries to ambush the Group from behind. Jonathan easily kills him with a Ripple-infused kick.

Adams initally appears as a normal short haired man of medium build and height. However he has an abnormally long tongue.

When he sheds his disguise, Adams reveals himself as a zombie possessing a bony crest on the head and becomes much more muscular.

Adams initially appears as a normal if somewhat childish villager, mimicking a cow as he tells Poco that his sister threatens to lock the child in a barn.
